text:
sara_sales: hey @eng, NewCorp's security team returned the security questionnaire with a blocker: they require their on-prem HSM to keep private key material, plus a signed cert-chain / CSR exchange for the POC. Timeline is next week. who can own the KMS/HSM handoff and cert exchange? :pray:

james_se: i can take point. quick q — are they asking for BYOK where keys never leave their HSM, or do they expect a wrapped-key model so we can operate on tokens?

alyssa_infra: they wrote 'HSM-backed key material, private key must remain in customer HSM' — so BYOK with key-wrapping for service accounts. we'll need either their public key / CA bundle or a CSR-signing flow performed inside their HSM. also need accepted algorithms (RSA/ECDSA) and attestation.

sara_sales: copying procurement too — they also asked for a pricing note: if BYOK forces Dedicated pool vs hosted, they want a delta. can we provide a quick estimate and call out any enterprise blockers?

james_se: for a short POC we can run hosted + BYOK (wrap/unwrap) in most cases; Dedicated only required if they need isolated GPUs or contractual SLA. cost estimate depends on target throughput and retention. infra items to collect now:
- CSR / subject details we should use
- HSM attestation doc (certified vendor + module)
- ephemeral cert rotation cadence
- allowed IP CIDRs for VPC peering or private link

alyssa_infra: provisioning checklist (short):
- customer provides HSM public key and CA bundle
- we generate CSR for the service cert and send to customer
- customer signs CSR inside their HSM and returns signed cert
- validate cert chain + fingerprint on our side
- wrap encryption key (EK) with customer's public key and store wrapped blob in vault
- map wrapped key to the private deployment config and run handshake tests
- run one end-to-end inference with signed cert present

alyssa_infra: ```
# sample CSR generation (we only generate CSR, customer signs inside HSM)
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:3072 -nodes -keyout service.key -out service.csr -subj '/CN=redwood-poc-newcorp'
# customer-side (inside HSM): sign CSR -> service.crt (performed by customer HSM)
# verify fingerprint after they return cert:
openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -inform pem -in service.crt
```

security_representative: security notes: require HSM attestation (vendor-signed) as part of BYOK. mandate an auditable attestation doc and key provenance. rotation: for the POC enforce cert rotation every 90 days and require audit events for any unwrap/wrap operations. we should also add a short SLA clause for key usage and an emergency revoke flow.

sara_sales: thanks — i've asked NewCorp for their attestation doc, CA bundle, and preferred subject fields. proposed exchange window: Fri 09:00 PT for the CSR/cert handoff. can we block 1h for the handshake and initial test?

devops_bot: ticket TKT-4821 created: "NewCorp private POC - HSM key exchange" assigned to @james_se, @alyssa_infra. link: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/TKT-4821

james_se: i'm good for Fri 09:00 PT, will produce a concise cost/throughput estimate by EOD Thu. i'll also prepare a small test harness to validate the signed cert and wrapped key flow.

sara_sales: perfect — i'll update the SQA and send procurement a short note about Dedicated vs Hosted with BYOK constraints. cc @security_representative for attestation follow-up. :thumbsup:
